command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP: baseline"
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

echo "== STEP: create data dir"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n chown -R inventory-worker:inventory-worker /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory

echo "== STEP: worker script"
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
OUT=/var/lib/inventory/inventory.log
while true; do
  printf '%s heartbeat pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$$" >> "$OUT"
  sleep 10
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== STEP: unit file"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
Restart=always

# Sandboxing: writes confined to /var/lib/inventory, no new privileges
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
RestrictRealtime=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== STEP: enable+start"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

sleep 3
echo "== STEP: verify status"
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ReadWritePaths

echo "== STEP: verify data written"
sleep 8
ls -la /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log

echo "== STEP: verify no-new-privs enforced (attempt sudo from within service context is n/a; check systemd status flags)"
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager | head -20
